answer_2.quote: we calculate the percentage accuracy for each attribute, where we train a gender classifier and use amplitude RMS and average F0 of the voiced part for volume and range evaluation... we also calculate R-FFE for melodic accuracy between the synthesized and reference singing...

answer_4.quote: For each evaluated model, we mix all generated results together and randomly select 220 items with their corresponding prompts for subjective evaluation. Our subjective evaluation tests are crowdsourced and conducted via Amazon Mechanical Turk... The testers rate scores on 1-5 Likert scales. We ask the testers to examine the audio quality and naturalness and ignore the content... we instruct the testers to evaluate the relevance between the natural language prompt and the singing style while ignoring the content.
answer_4.guideline: Raters are asked to rate singing voice quality (audio quality and naturalness) and prompt‑style relevance on a 1‑5 Likert scale, ignoring content.
